<user_query>
In the AllTrue codebase, explore the frontend code related to:

1. `frontend/src/pages/StudentsList.vue` - how courses are created, and any "first session" or "start date" picking UI
2. `frontend/src/composables/course-management/useCourseSessionsDisplay.js` - how session status is displayed and what happens when clicking a session slot
3. `frontend/src/lib/classSessionsApi.js` - what API calls are made when a session is clicked/marked
4. `frontend/src/lib/universalSchedulerApi.js` - any session creation/update logic

Return:
- The UI flow for creating a new course and picking its first session date
- What happens when a future date is clicked (does it mark as "attended"?)
- How `Status` is set when creating a new session vs clicking an existing one
- Any "手動" (manual) date input fields in the course creation wizard
</user_query>

Searching and reading the listed frontend files to map course creation, session clicks, and API behavior.

[REDACTED]

Searching StudentsList.vue for course-creation flow, wizard, and date-related UI.

[REDACTED]

Here is a concise report based on the files you named and closely related callers. --- ## 1. `StudentsList.vue` — creating a course and “first session” / start date **How a new course is opened** - User expands a student row and clicks **「新增課程」** → `openAddCourse` → optional duplicate intercept (`GET /api/v1/students/:id/active-courses`) → `proceedOpenAddCourse`. - `proceedOpenAddCourse` sets `editingCourseId = null`, initializes `courseForm` (including `first_class_date: today`), opens the modal (`showCourseModal = true`). **What the UI actually shows for a *new* course** - The template only shows **`UniversalClassScheduler`** when `showCourseModal && !editingCourseId` (create path). **`CourseEditForm` is only shown when `editingCourseId` is set** (edit path). ```385:435:frontend/src/pages/StudentsList.vue

編輯課程

...
... ``` So **new course creation in StudentsList is the universal scheduler flow**, not the `CourseEditForm` + `submitCourse` POST to `/api/v1/student-classes` path. The latter block still exists under `submitCourse` when `!editingCourseId`, but with the current template there is **no modal** that shows `CourseEditForm` for that case, so that branch is effectively unused for the visible “新增課程” flow. **“First session” / start in the universal flow** - First/last session **dates** are chosen by: - **Fixed weekdays + times** (`days_of_week`, `day_time_slots`), which drive **future** occurrences. - **Manual calendar clicks** (`onDateClick` in `UniversalClassScheduler.vue`), which add/remove dates in `form.confirmed_dates` (shown as **「手動」** on cells and in the summary). - On submit, those become a **`session_plan`** with each row labeled `kind: 'confirmed'` or `'future'` (see section 4 below), sent via `createUniversalClassSchedule` → `POST /api/v1/class-sessions/batch`. **Other date fields on StudentsList (not the main create wizard)** - **加購堂數** modal: **「新批次開始日期」** — `input type="date"` bound to `addSessionStartDate` (around line 1975 in script; template lines 457–459). - **`CourseEditForm`** (edit only) includes **「開課日」** `first_class_date` — see `CourseEditForm.vue` labels around the `type="date"` input for 開課日. --- ## 2. `useCourseSessionsDisplay.js` — display and “clicking a session slot” This composable **does not attach click handlers**. It provides: - **Status display**: `getSessionState` maps row `status` to labels/classes (e.g. attended/completed/late → **「已上」** with class `completed`; `scheduled` → no chip label; leave variants → 請假/補請假; `absent` → 缺席; `cancelled` → 取消). See `getSessionState` (roughly lines 284–303). - **Tooltips**: `getSessionTooltip` builds status, time range, attendance time, recorder. - **Data loading**: `fetchClassSessionsFn` (typically `fetchClassSessions` from `classSessionsApi.js`), `loadEffectiveSessionDates` (`POST /api/v1/student-classes/session-dates`), `ensureCompletedSessionDatesLoaded`. - **Local PATCH after edits**: `updateLocalSessionRow` merges updated `status`/times into cached rows (used after modal saves elsewhere). **Where clicks happen**: e.g. `CourseManagement.vue` uses chips with `@click="openSessionEdit(...)"` — that opens `SessionEditModal` via `useSessionEditFlow`, **not** inside this composable. `StudentsList.vue` does **not** import `useCourseSessionsDisplay`. --- ## 3. `classSessionsApi.js` — APIs when a session is “clicked / marked” This file **only implements loading**: - `GET /api/v1/class-sessions` with query params (`branch_id`, `student_class_id`, `student_class_ids`, optional `teacher_id`, `student_id`, `start`, `end`, `per_page`). - `normalizeClassSessionsPayload` deduplicates by `id` and normalizes fields. There are **no** PATCH/POST helpers here. **Marking** a session is done in **`useSessionEditFlow.js`**: `PATCH /api/v1/class-sessions/:id` with `{ status, reason }` (and similar for retro-leave). --- ## 4. `universalSchedulerApi.js` — create/update logic **Single export**: `createUniversalClassSchedule(payload)` → **`POST /api/v1/class-sessions/batch`** with JSON body (includes `confirmed_dates`, `future_dates` as arrays in the API wrapper normalization, plus the richer `session_plan` built in the component). There is **no** update route in this file; updates to existing sessions are elsewhere (e.g. `PATCH` in `useSessionEditFlow`). --- ## Direct answers to your bullets ### UI flow for creating a new course and picking the first session date 1. **新增課程** → duplicate check → **UniversalClassScheduler** (`mode="create"`). 2. Choose student, teacher, subject, payment type, **fixed weekdays** and per-day slots, optional room/memo. 3. Use the **month calendar**: click days to toggle **手動** dates (`confirmed_dates`). Future fills come from **固定星期** (`futureSessionOccurrences`). 4. **建立課程並寫入堂次** → `createUniversalClassSchedule` → batch API. “First” session date is **not** a single dedicated “開課日” field in this wizard; it is implied by the **earliest date** in the combined manual + auto-generated `session_plan`. ### When a **future** date is clicked, does it mark as “attended”? **No.** A calendar click only toggles membership in `confirmed_dates`. When building `session_plan`, each manual date gets: ```1358:1381:frontend/src/components/UniversalClassScheduler.vue for (const ymd of manualDates.value) { const dow = weekdayOneToSeven(new Date(`${ymd}T12:00:00`)); const indices = getSlotIndicesForDay(dow); const kind = isManualDateConfirmed(ymd) ? 'confirmed' : 'future'; ... sessionPlan.push({ session_date: ymd, ... kind, ``` For **`ymd > today`**, `isManualDateConfirmed` returns **false**, so **`kind` is `'future'`** — i.e. **future scheduling**, not “已上/attended”. Past/today semantics use `isManualDateConfirmed` (including “today after latest end time” → treated like completed for `kind`). ### How `Status` is set: **new session (batch)** vs **clicking an existing one** | Context | Mechanism | |--------|-----------| | **New course (universal batch)** | Frontend sends `session_plan` entries with `kind` **`confirmed`** vs **`future`**. The **HTTP `Status` string** on `ClassSession` rows is determined **on the server** when processing `/class-sessions/batch` (not assigned in `universalSchedulerApi.js`). | | **Existing session (chip → modal)** | User changes status in **`SessionEditModal`** / `useSessionEditFlow` → **`PATCH /api/v1/class-sessions/:id`** with `{ status }`. Allowed transitions are defined in `SESSION_STATUS_TRANSITIONS` in `useSessionEditFlow.js` (e.g. `scheduled` → `attended`, `late`, `absent`, `leave`, `cancelled`). | ### 「手動」 (manual) date inputs in course creation - **Universal scheduler calendar**: manual picks are **click-to-toggle** on the grid; cells show **「手動」**; list under **「手動指定日期」**; **「清除手動日期」** clears `confirmed_dates`. - **Package mode** inside the same component: per-subject **`start_date`** `type="date"` (`pkg-inline-date`). - **StudentsList** `CourseEditForm` path: **開課日** `first_class_date` exists in **`CourseEditForm.vue`**, but that form is tied to **`editingCourseId`** (edit), not the universal **create** modal. - **加購** modal: **新批次開始日期** (`type="date"`). --- **File references (absolute)** - `/home/admin/frontend/src/pages/StudentsList.vue` - `/home/admin/frontend/src/components/UniversalClassScheduler.vue` - `/home/admin/frontend/src/components/CourseEditForm.vue` - `/home/admin/frontend/src/composables/course-management/useCourseSessionsDisplay.js` - `/home/admin/frontend/src/lib/classSessionsApi.js` - `/home/admin/frontend/src/lib/universalSchedulerApi.js` - `/home/admin/frontend/src/composables/course-management/useSessionEditFlow.js` (session mark / PATCH) - `/home/admin/frontend/src/pages/CourseManagement.vue` (chip click → `openSessionEdit`) [REDACTED]
